item.title: Suddenly Calling It A Special Seems A Bit Problematic
item.description: Read Suddenly Calling It A Special Seems A Bit Problematic Manager: "Who wrote the sign for today's special?" Me: "Brian, why?" Manager: "It's wrong." Me: "Is it not Asparagus Frittata?" Manager: "Oh, it certainly is." Read Suddenly Calling It A Special Seems A Bit Problematic

item.title: The Wizard And I Have Made A Mistake
item.description: Read The Wizard And I Have Made A Mistake A customer comes out of a screening of 'Wicked: For Good' that’s been showing for about forty minutes. Customer: "Are they going to keep singing?" Read The Wizard And I Have Made A Mistake

item.title: Sidelining Sense
item.description: Read Sidelining Sense Me: "Side salads. Do you sell them here? Employee: "No. What kind of salad do you want?" I couldn't see any salads on the menu. Me: "I don't know, what kind do you have?" She lists the types of salads. Employee: "…and side salads." Read Sidelining Sense

item.title: This Customer Is Taking Generations To Checkout
item.description: Read This Customer Is Taking Generations To Checkout I find a line at the grocery store that is surprisingly shorter than the others. I get in line and overhear the customer talking at (not to) the cashier: Customer: "You know, you got two parents, four grandparents, eight great grandparents, sixteen great great grandparents..." Read This Customer Is Taking Generations To Checkout

item.title: Seizing Any Opportunity To Complain
item.description: Read Seizing Any Opportunity To Complain Just as this poor guy's starting to come to, I hear a woman clear her throat above me. I look up, and it's the same woman who came and told me about the seizure in the first place. Customer: "Are you going to be able to help me soon? I really have to leave, and I didn't think this was going to take this long." Read Seizing Any Opportunity To Complain
